description: This Java class 'ModelKeyMap' models the '<key-map>' element in an entity model, providing constructors, getters, factory methods, and XML serialization for key mappings between entity fields.

classes.name: ModelKeyMap
classes.description: Immutable class representing a key mapping between entity fields, with methods for comparison, equality, and XML conversion.

methods.name: ModelKeyMap
methods.description: Constructor initializing from field names, with relFieldName defaulting to fieldName if null.

methods.name: ModelKeyMap
methods.description: Constructor initializing from an XML Element, extracting attributes for field names.

methods.name: getFieldName
methods.description: Returns the name of the field in the entity.

methods.name: getRelFieldName
methods.description: Returns the name of the related entity's field.

methods.name: makeKeyMapList
methods.description: Factory methods creating lists of ModelKeyMap instances with varying numbers of key mappings.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Generates hash code based on fullName.

methods.name: toXmlElement
methods.description: Serializes the ModelKeyMap to an XML Element.

methods.name: compareTo
methods.description: Compares two ModelKeyMap instances based on fullName.
